editorial:
Imagine being trapped in a house during a massive snowstorm with your family and the constant fear that you are on Santa's naughty list. That is exactly where you find Greg Heffley in this holiday chaos. You get to follow Greg as he tries to avoid chores and stay out of trouble, but as usual, his plans backfire in the funniest ways possible. The vibe is light, silly, and perfect for a cozy night in. It captures that feeling of being a kid who just wants to play video games while the adults are stressing out over holiday decorations and winter weather.

The animation keeps things moving quickly, so you will not feel bored for a second. While the plot is simple, the humor hits home if you have ever felt like the odd one out in your own family. One downside is that it feels a bit short, but it is a great choice for families with young kids. You should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Disney Plus for the best colors, or you can grab the 4K Blu-ray if you like keeping physical copies of your favorite holiday movies.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Greg's lies and mishaps finally catch up to him during the storm. After a series of disasters around the house, Greg realizes that being honest is better than trying to trick his parents. The movie wraps up with the family bonding despite the chaos. Greg does not get everything he wanted, but he learns a small lesson about family and kindness just in time for Christmas morning.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves funny family stories and the Wimpy Kid books.
